"Unsent data and DNSE keys on this device will be deleted."
"The backend will read the current planning file and save a version. This does not place an order."
Trading data is shown for reference. Place manual orders in Orders → Upcoming; always check actual status on DNSE.
"Admin: choose a source in management to view data from all accounts."
"You only see data uploaded by this account. The backend automatically updates the configured planning file."
"Configure Firebase and backend mobile access before signing in."
Production and Sandbox keys are encrypted separately on this device per Google account. Switching environments does not copy keys. Sandbox data stays on this device.
"DNSE keys saved. Delete them to enter new keys."
"Every 6 hours when online. Android may delay execution; force stopping prevents scheduled work until you reopen the app."
"Choose a source to view orders, balances, positions, executions and sync batches. Orders and Sync also display the selected source."
"Updates automatically when new notifications arrive • Content is stored on this device"
Content is stored on this device. Notifications do not automatically place or cancel orders; check the current status on DNSE.
"No DNSE account data yet. Save your keys and sync to view it."
"The API has not provided a name, email or phone number in its response."
"No stock positions in the synced data."
Plans scheduled at or after the current device time. Only this tab allows orders; approval, execution window, source and cash are still verified before calling DNSE.
Plans scheduled before the current device time, for viewing only. Appearing here does not mean an order was executed or filled.
"No orders or plans in this group yet."
"Source: DNSE order history and today\'s orders / synced data"
"Welcome. Sign in to connect to planning."
"Not completed. Check sign-in configuration, connectivity and data format."
"This build has no Firebase configuration. You can check the server; complete the configuration to sign in."
"Sign in with Google, then verify backend access."
Production selected. The app uses only the saved Production keys.
Sandbox selected. The app uses only the saved Sandbox keys.
Deleted the API key and secret for the selected environment. Keys for the other environment are preserved.
"Admin access verified. All data sources are accessible."
"This is synced data, not confirmation of a new trade."
"Backend access is required before enabling the schedule."
"Sync enabled every 6 hours; Android may delay it in battery saving mode."
"Device removed from the backend and local keys/data cleared for this session."
"Open the notification to view the plan update."
"Firebase sign-in is not configured for this build."
"No eligible Google account on this device."
"Check the SHA-256 certificate and Play Integrity configuration for builds installed outside Google Play in Firebase App Check. "
"Google sign-in succeeded, but App Check has not verified the app. "
"If you have retried several times, wait and tap Check access."
"DNSE rejected the API key in %1$s. Check that you have the correct, valid keys for this environment."
"DNSE rejected the signature/authentication in %1$s. Check that the secret matches the key and enable automatic time on your phone."
"DNSE denied access in %1$s. Check key permissions and the subaccount."
"DNSE returned an error in %1$s; data retrieval is incomplete."
"DNSE repeated a data page; stopped to avoid missing orders."
"History exceeds 100 pages; use shorter date ranges."
"DNSE is missing a required field; the record has not been uploaded to the backend."
"DNSE balances.stock is not an object; the balance has not been uploaded."
"DNSE: cash could not be read from balances.stock.availableCash; the balance has not been uploaded to the backend."
"Cannot connect to DNSE. Pending data is retained. [%1$s]"
"Cannot connect to the server. Pending data will be retained. [%1$s]"
"This Google account is not authorized by the backend. Use the planning owner\'s account. [owner_only]"
"The sign-in identity differs from the identity saved by the backend. Check the account link. [identity_changed]"
"This build\'s Firebase App ID does not match the backend configuration. [invalid_mobile_app]"
"The backend could not verify the Firebase session. [invalid_firebase_token]"
"The backend has not accepted App Check verification. [%1$s]"
"The server has not authorized this session. [HTTP %1$s / %2$s]"
"Data version conflict. The upload is retained for review."
"Data does not match the backend format. The upload is retained for review."
"The server is rate limiting requests. Will retry later."
"Sign in to access data on this device."
"The server returned a repeated notification page."
"Save the API key and secret first."
"Backend mobile access is not verified. Check the connection."
"DNSE returned two different records with the same timestamp."
"Read %1$s orders, %2$s executions and %3$s sandbox positions on this device; nothing uploaded to live planning."
"Synced %1$s orders, %2$s executions, %3$s positions and %4$s balances. Sheet: %5$s"
"Backend mobile access has not been granted."
"A data batch needs reconciliation. Do not create a new batch to bypass the error."
"No backend data persistence confirmation received yet."
Current FCM token copied. Use this token when testing from Firebase Console.
Tokens may change. Use the current token for Firebase Console tests; the backend updates new tokens automatically.
No plans are saved on this device. Sign in and tap Refresh plans to load them for the first time.
"Read fresh DNSE data, save it on this device and upload it to the backend for the signed-in account. Sandbox data stays on this device. This does not place orders."
"Retry batches saved on this device that the backend has not acknowledged. DNSE is not read again. The button shows the number of pending batches; batches requiring review are retained for review."
"This controls backend writes of DNSE data to Google Sheets. When off, data may still be saved on the backend; it does not mean the upload failed."
"This status comes from the backend and does not confirm that each batch has been written to Sheets. If unavailable, use Check access to reconnect."

"Ask Android to let this app display notifications on your device. This permission does not register an FCM token or enable backend sending. Android will not ask again if permission is already granted."
Submits after your confirmation and backend execution checks. Supports stock limit orders (LO). Enter the full VND price (e.g. VND 25,950 → 25950).
No trading sub-account (dealAccount) found. Check the API key and DNSE environment.
Only DNSE type N (no-loan) packages are shown. Type M or a missing type is blocked to prevent margin use.

Sub-account: %1$s
%2$s · %3$s · LO
Quantity: %4$d shares
Price: %5$s / share
Estimated value: %6$s (excluding fees)
Trading package: %7$s
Use the OTP method registered with DNSE. Get Smart OTP in EntradeX using the OTP for another device option. OTP verification does not place an order; only the final confirmation sends it.
OTP verified. Review the order before confirming.
Check the symbol, Buy/Sell, positive whole VND price and quantity. Odd lots: 1–99; round lots: multiples of 100. Do not use number separators.
Cannot connect to or read DNSE trading data. Check your connection, API key and environment, then reopen this screen.
DNSE rejected the request (HTTP %1$d). Check the OTP method, code and API key trading permissions.
Requested an OTP to the email registered with DNSE.
DNSE received the order request. This does not confirm a fill. Use Sync now to update actual trading status.
The submission result is unknown. Do not resend to avoid duplicate orders. Check DNSE/EntradeX and use Sync now.
This plan already has an order submission on this device. Check DNSE before proceeding.
The plan changed or is no longer upcoming. Refresh and review it again.
Verify OTP again before submitting the order.
No balance for the current DNSE configuration. Go to Settings → Sync now.
Required budget is unknown. Check the LO price, quantity and value in planning.
Cannot place this buy order. Top up in the DNSE app, then go to this app’s Settings → Sync now. The order button appears only when a sub-account can fund the entire order.

Each order is compared separately with available cash, including planning fee reserves/budget. Cash is not combined across sub-accounts and margin buying power is not used. DNSE checks actual fees and trading permissions on submission.
API key and secret are saved for %1$s. Keys are hidden; delete them to enter new ones.
No %1$s keys saved. Enter the API key and secret for this environment, then tap Save keys.
Checks whether the backend is running and the app can connect to it. Available before signing in.
Verifies backend access for the signed-in Google account, refreshes permissions and registers this device for notifications. Sign in first.
This Google account identifies your access permissions and personal data on the backend.
A verified status means the backend has validated this account’s access. Use Check access to verify and refresh it.
Shows whether this device’s FCM token is registered with the backend for this account. Registration does not confirm delivery of a specific notification.
Shows whether Android allows this app to display notifications on this device. If disabled, use Allow notifications below.
Review data synced by accounts and manage shared plans. Choose a section above to see details.
Shows whether the backend enables writing data to Sheets and how many batches await writing. This is the status reported by the backend.
Backend data is shown for the selected account. Shared plans are in the Plans section.
Reloads current status and data from the backend.
No account selected. Open Accounts and select the data you want to view.
Tap an account to view balances, holdings, orders and fills uploaded to the backend. The selected account is highlighted.
This data was saved on the backend during previous syncs. Choose a category below; counts include only records already loaded.
Loaded %1$d records for the selected account.
No data in this category among loaded records. If available, tap More records below.
These actions have different purposes: read plans from Sheets into the backend, or write trading data from the backend to Sheets.
The backend reads the configured planning file and saves a new plan snapshot. Confirmation is required; this action does not place DNSE orders.
Write trading data to Google Sheet
Asks the backend to reconcile and write existing trading data to Sheets. Writing is performed only when Sheet writing is enabled.
Sheet writing is disabled on the backend. Updating will not write data until this feature is enabled.
These plans are from the saved snapshot, not confirmation of executed orders. Place manual orders in Orders → Upcoming.
No saved plans yet. Use Reload plans to read them from Sheets.
All three tabs share data saved on this device. Upcoming and History follow the device clock; opening the app or switching tabs does not reload plans.
Loads every plan, then saves all three tabs together. If loading fails, the previous data is retained.
All plans refreshed and saved on this device for all three tabs.
Uses only DNSE Sandbox and separate Sandbox keys. Simulated data and funds; no Production orders. Authentication uses simulated OTP 666666.
Select Sandbox, enter and save its API Key and API Secret to enable testing.
Inspect HTTP status and DNSE JSON responses for account reads, simulated placement and cancellation. Always uses Sandbox keys even when Production is selected.
The request outcome is unknown. Check its status before another submission; orders are never automatically resubmitted.
A new test requires the previous order to finish or be rejected. Sandbox simulates fills automatically, so cancellation may be rejected after a fill.

SANDBOX • BUY
Account: %1$s
Symbol: %2$s
Quantity: %3$d
LO price: %4$s
Value: %5$s
Uses simulated funds only.
Invalid DNSE credentials. Enter API Key and API Secret separately, without labels, spaces or line breaks. Delete the keys for this environment and save the two correct values.
Check the account, symbol, quantity, price and trading package. If a previous test exists, read its order status before starting a new one.
Tap to select this trading package
Select a Sandbox account to continue.
Tap Load balance and trading packages to continue.
Select a trading package above to enable order placement.
Check the symbol, quantity and LO price.
The Sandbox order is ready for review and submission.
Sends DELETE immediately after a successful POST using the same trading token, before Sandbox simulates a fill.
The previous cancellation outcome is unknown or the request was already sent. Read the order status; the app will not automatically send DELETE again.
The order was updated in the backend and the Planning Sheet for this environment.
DNSE accepted the order. The backend or Planning Sheet has not confirmed it yet; the app saved the request and will retry with the same ID to avoid duplicates.
This legacy plan is read-only and has no verified execution data, so it cannot place an order.
The app could not verify the latest execution conditions with the backend. The plan remains readable, but no DNSE order can be sent.
Another device already claimed execution of this plan. The app blocked an additional DNSE order.
The backend execution path is disabled.
A newer plan version exists. Refresh and review it before taking action.
The plan has not been approved by a user or administrator.
This plan is for research only and cannot be executed.
This plan was superseded by another version.
This plan is terminal and cannot create a new order.
A previous execution result is unknown and must be reconciled before continuing.
DNSE has already accepted an order for this plan.
The current server time is outside the allowed execution window.
The plan does not have a valid execution window.
The selected DNSE environment does not match the plan.
The DNSE sub-account does not match the plan.
The order quantity does not match the approved plan.
The limit price does not match the approved plan.
The plan is not assigned to the signed-in Google account.
The plan does not specify a DNSE sub-account.
The plan does not specify an authorized recipient.
Execution conditions are missing or invalid, so the app blocked the order.
The backend marked this plan eligible when last loaded. The app will still check again immediately before calling DNSE.
This is locally cached data and is read-only. Refresh the plans while online to check eligibility before taking action.
All saved plans, including executed, unexecuted and planning-only entries. This tab is read-only.
This tab is read-only. Order actions are available only in Upcoming when all execution conditions are met.
Orders can only be placed from Upcoming with an exact scheduled time that has not passed.
